PDF fixtures used for integration tests:

Run npm test to download the two public fixtures below when they are missing.
The downloaded files are ignored by Git.

research-paper.pdf: Mozilla PDF.js example copy of Gal et al.,
Trace-based Just-in-Time Type Specialization for Dynamic Languages (PLDI 2009).
https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/compressed.tracemonkey-pldi-09.pdf
Copyright and permissions appear on page 1 of the PDF.

second-paper.pdf: W3C PDF test fixture, "Dummy PDF file".
https://www.w3.org/WAI/ER/tests/xhtml/testfiles/resources/pdf/dummy.pdf

continuous-pages.pdf: A generated four-page test document with printed page
labels 101 through 104. This synthetic fixture is included in the repository.

These files are test inputs, not personal research notes.
